The most recent Republican to be elected Governor of New York was **George Pataki**, who won the 1994 election and served from 1995 to 2006.

When Pataki was first elected, his name appeared on the ballot under **three party lines**:

| Party line | Source |
|------------|--------|
| Republican | New York State Board of Elections – 1994 governor contest list (shows “George Pataki … Republican / …”)【1†L15-L17】 |
| Conservative | Same contest list (shows “… Conservative …”)【1†L15-L17】 |
| Tax Cut Now | Same contest list (shows “… Tax Cut Now”)【1†L15-L17】 |

Thus, the Republican Governor elected most recently was George Pataki, and he ran on the **Republican, Conservative, and Tax Cut Now** ballot lines when first elected.
